translations.web: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.
translations.bsb: He who goes out weeping, bearing a trail of seed, will surely return with shouts of joy, carrying sheaves of grain.
translations.kjv: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves
